title: The Three-Dimensional Stochastic EMHD System: Local Well-Posedness and Maximal Pathwise Solutions
summary: We study the three-dimensional stochastic electron magnetohydrodynamics (EMHD) system with fractional dissipation on the torus, driven by Stratonovich transport noise acting through divergence-free first-order operators. The noise generates an Itô correction while preserving the transport structure of the Hall nonlinearity. Since the Hall term contains one more derivative, in the stochastic setting it must be controlled together with commutators arising from the transport operators.
